'''''One With The Force''''' is an unreleased documentary project by [[Brandon Baity]] on the rise, fall, and rebirth of ''Star Wars'' CCG. Baity posted a teaser trailer on 2 February 2020. The description calls it a three-part documentary.<ref name="teaser">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ALWy-2SwGWM One With The Force Teaser Trailer], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (2 February 2020). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ALWy-2SwGWM Internet Archive].</ref>

The film was not released. A GoFundMe campaign launched 16 December 2017 under Creative, organizer Brandon Baity, Portland, Oregon, with a $10,000 goal. The campaign page listed $11,069 from 113 donors and remained marked 0% complete (paused) after passing the goal.<ref name="gfm">[https://www.gofundme.com/f/star-wars-ccg-documentary Star Wars CCG Documentary], GoFundMe (Brandon Baity, 16 December 2017)</ref><ref name="gfm-vid">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S86h_mItIG0 One With The Force GoFundMe Campaign Video], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (16 December 2017). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-S86h_mItIG0 Internet Archive].</ref> The campaign names [[Brian Terwilliger]] as co-producer and [[Chris Menzel]] on marketing.
